body.statement: For the full scores from def:full-score-covariance, including the harmonic translation score and the covariance between the leading and generated-target responses within each control cell, \(\sup_{P\in\mathcal F_s}\lVert\Sigma_{h_n}(P)-V(P)\rVert_{\mathrm{op}}\to0\), where \(V(P)=\operatorname{diag}(V_1,\ldots,V_J)\), \(V_j=w_j\sqrt{\det H(y_j)}H(y_j)/(4\pi f_{T1}(y_j))\), and \(w_j=\alpha(y_j)(\rho_{C0}^{-1}+\rho_{C1}^{-1})+\rho_{T0}^{-1}+\rho_{T1}^{-1}\). The normalized harmonic variance and every Green--harmonic cross-covariance vanish by the uniform \(L^2\) bound in thm:nested-derivative.
body.justification: The closed form records the exact cell weights and shows why independent-cell noise cannot cancel the critical logarithm.
body.gap: ManoleBalakrishnanNilesWeedWasserman2023CLT gives a one-sample uniform-law dimension-two block and no generated-target paths; the displayed covariance is four-sample, variable-coefficient, and nested.
body.consumer: The block matrices provide interpretable standard-error diagnostics and an independent check on the adjoint numerical implementation.

obligation.what_is_open: Upgrade the algebraic four-cell frozen-pole covariance to operator-norm convergence of the exact full score covariance, uniformly over \(\mathcal F_s\).
obligation.obstruction: The second elliptic and harmonic pieces are bounded, but the leading transformed-KDE response still needs the unresolved uniform coefficient, generated-target, and moving-pole stability from oeq:uniform-critical-control.
obligation.attempted: The cellwise mass identities, local intensities, anisotropic angular constant, independence across cells, and absence of off-grid logarithmic cross terms were derived explicitly.
obligation.partial_result:
The mass-change identities at a pole \(y\), with \(x=R_0(y)\), are
\[
f_{C0}(x)\det D(y)=f_{C1}(T(y))\det H(y)=\frac{f_{T1}(y)}{\alpha(y)},
\]
\[
f_{T0}(x)\det D(y)=f_{T1}(y).
\]
Thus multiplication by the leading control weight \(\alpha(y)\) gives local noise intensity \(\alpha(y)f_{T1}(y)\) for each control cell, while each treated cell has intensity \(f_{T1}(y)\).  A frozen coefficient \(B(y)\) maps intensity \(q_y\) to the logarithmic covariance
\[
\frac{q_y B(y)^{-1}}{4\pi\sqrt{\det B(y)}}.
\]
Since \(B=f_{T1}H^{-1}\), summing independent cells gives algebraically
\[
\frac{\bigl[\alpha(y)(\rho_{C0}^{-1}+\rho_{C1}^{-1})+
ho_{T0}^{-1}+\rho_{T1}^{-1}\bigr]
\sqrt{\det H(y)}H(y)}{4\pi f_{T1}(y)}.
\]
Distinct fixed grid points have distinct pulled-back poles, so their cross blocks have no logarithmic term.  What remains unproved is that the full variable-coefficient, transformed-KDE score differs from these frozen-pole responses by \(o(\sqrt{L_n})\) in \(L^2\), uniformly over \(\mathcal F_s\).
